coverage.note: subset limited by --max-samples; NOT a full training-split statistic

element_counting.action: valid elements of every training window (episode-safe plan, action_mask applied first, non-finite excluded); a raw frame in k valid windows contributes k times
element_counting.future: valid (F, V, P) future positions of every training window pooled per DINO channel; future_mask applied first, non-finite excluded
